headline: Araghchi restates reopening mechanics
dek: Araghchi said Tehran's seven-day Hormuz reopening proposal remains on the table: 'If they act on those conditions, the Strait will be opened on the sixth day and negotiations will begin on the seventh day.' Decision rests with Washington.
sources: FM Abbas Araghchi via Gulf News live blog
